dict.string: Rove Explorer asks Finder to move items to the Trash and to show Get Info windows.
Rove Explorer needs access to browse and manage files on your Desktop.
Rove Explorer needs access to browse and manage files in your Documents folder.
Rove Explorer needs access to browse and manage files in your Downloads folder.
Rove Explorer needs access to browse and manage files on removable drives.
Rove Explorer needs access to browse and manage files on network drives.
